checks.describe: platformops --help lists validate, inspect and version

checks.describe: platformops --help also lists inspect and version
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv run platformops --help 2>&1 | grep -c -e inspect -e version

checks.describe: validate on a good file reports OK and exits 0
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv run platformops validate service.yaml > /dev/null 2>&1; echo $?

checks.describe: validate on a bad file names the missing field and exits 1
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv run platformops validate service-bad.yaml; echo "EXIT:$?"

checks.describe: validate on a missing file reports not-found and exits 1
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv run platformops validate service-does-not-exist.yaml > /dev/null 2>&1; echo $?

checks.describe: validate --json on a good file prints an object with status ok that a machine can parse
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv run platformops validate service.yaml --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['status'])"

checks.describe: validate --json on a bad file prints a parseable error object and still exits 1
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv run platformops validate service-bad.yaml --json 2>/dev/null > /tmp/m8-check-validate.json; EXIT=$?; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/tmp/m8-check-validate.json')); print(d['status'])"; echo "EXIT:$EXIT"

checks.describe: inspect prints the plain-text inventory report and exits 0
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv run platformops inspect > /dev/null 2>&1; echo $?

checks.describe: inspect --json prints a parseable object with the correct total_servers count
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv run platformops inspect --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['total_servers'])"

checks.describe: platformops version reports the current installed version, not a stale hardcoded one
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv run platformops version

checks.describe: --quiet produces no stdout on a successful validate
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv run platformops --quiet validate service.yaml 2>/dev/null | wc -c | tr -d ' '

checks.describe: --quiet still reports a real validation failure on stdout
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv run platformops --quiet validate service-bad.yaml 2>/dev/null

checks.describe: --verbose surfaces DEBUG-level log lines on stderr that a plain run does not show
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv run platformops --verbose validate service.yaml 2>&1 1>/dev/null

checks.describe: combining --verbose and --quiet is rejected with exit code 2, distinct from a validation failure's exit code 1
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv run platformops --verbose --quiet version > /dev/null 2>&1; echo $?

checks.describe: the installed console-script shim in .venv/bin/platformops resolves to platformops.cli:app -- proof the [project.scripts] wiring took effect
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv sync > /dev/null 2>&1 && grep -c 'from platformops.cli import app' .venv/bin/platformops

checks.describe: cli.py routes command-level errors through one shared helper instead of each command formatting its own
checks.run: grep -c 'def _fail' labs/checkpoints/v0.6/src/platformops/cli.py
